page.title: How referrals work
page.description: Refer estate agents to PropertyList and earn credits when they join and become active. Both agents benefit with rewards redeemable on all paid features.
page.body:
How to Use the PropertyList Referral Program (Step-by-Step Guide)


Our Referral Program is designed to be simple, transparent, and rewarding for everyone involved.
Earn €20 in credits for every agency that joins via your referral to PropertyList

🚀 Step 1: Copy Your Unique Referral Link

Inside your dashboard, you’ll find your personal referral link.  

👉 or click here

💬 Step 2: Share With the Right Agents

For best results, send a short personal message explaining why you think PropertyList will benefit them. (Free to join!)

✅ Step 3: Approval & Tracking

Once the referred agent registers, our admin team reviews and approves their account.

🎁 Step 4: Get Rewarded (Win-Win)

When your referred agent is approved:

Grow your network. Help other agents succeed. Get rewarded for it.


This link is unique to you and automatically tracks every agent who signs up through it - so you always get full credit for your referrals.


👉 Copy the link and share it directly with agents you know via WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn or even on your social media.

People respond best to:

  • Personal recommendations
  • Clear benefits
  • Simple next steps
  • When they sign up using your link, the system automatically records them under your name.
As soon as they are approved:
  • You’ll see them appear in your Referral Dashboard
  • You can track all your referrals in one place
  • Everything is fully transparent
  • No guessing. No manual reporting. The system handles it for you.

You receive 20 credits (worth €20)
&
They receive 20 credits (worth €20)

Both of you can use these credits toward featuring listings, ai tools, and all paid platform features.
You help another agent grow their business - and you both benefit immediately.
